features.note: Wide-low-deep 3U chassis, both zinc rack ears read (far-left and front-right). Envelope 0.4400 x 0.1310 x 0.6665 m — IDENTICAL to spec, unmoved by the structural work. No regression.

IMPROVED. The LCD went from a slab glued to the surface to RECESSED glass 1.2 mm behind a four-bar frame — which is what a display physically is (glass mounted behind a bezel). It now reads as a proper recessed screen, the dominant panel element, not a flat rectangle. Its back face used to sit EXACTLY on the bezel plane (a coincident pair Float32 resolves at random per camera); now it bites 0.6 mm in. The dark glass read completes in materials.

The power button went from a cylinder sitting on the paint to a cap RECESSED 2.8 mm inside a collar — what makes it read as a control rather than a decal. The 4 LEDs light green in the default hero (init-at-boot fix from the blockout carried forward). Button + LED column read as a rack-UPS control panel.

THE CRITICAL FIX. The front grille arrived as three BARS PROTRUDING from the bezel — the exact opposite of the opening this critical requires (no shading makes a bump read as a hole). Rebuilt as real recesses 2.5 mm behind the bezel face, each with a louvre blade formed INWARD so nothing juts out. AND the previously-EMPTY side_vents node now renders 18 slots across 396 mm of the 666 mm flank (visible as the perforated grid on the deep right side). Ventilation now reads on both the front and the side. At this flat-charcoal exposure the front recesses read subtly; the side vents carry the critical clearly, and materials/lighting will sharpen the front.

important_features.note: Deep 666 mm body reads strongly; the side-vent grid now reinforces the deep-flank read. No regression.

defects: Front-grille recesses read subtly at the flat blockout exposure (the side vents carry the ventilation critical); materials/lighting will sharpen the front recesses. Non-blocking.
Rear receptacle layout intentionally NOT built (see notes) — logged as an open item, not a defect.
Materials remain flat blockout charcoal (materials pass owns this).
corrections: Materials pass: LCD glass read (low roughness, faint on-state), and enough contrast on the front-grille recesses that they read as openings without relying on the side vents.
Keep the rear receptacle layout as an OPEN ITEM until a source appears; do not invent a count/type.

mechanical.notes: Console clean (0/0) on default and power=off. Budget 42/250 draws, 1144/400000 tris (up from the blockout's 13/208 as real structure was added). Envelope identical to spec. Framing fullyVisible/wellFramed/no-HUD at 16:9 and 16:10. THREE guards: verifyNoEmptyGroups (written specifically for this asset because it had passed a gate with TWO declared-but-empty nodes — side_vents and rear_panel — which a capture cannot reveal since you cannot see what is not there; now side_vents has 18 slots and rear_panel has 3 meshes), verifyNoCoincidentPlanes (the LCD/button/LEDs no longer sit on the bezel plane), and verifyVentsAreRecessed (asserts every grille throat is BEHIND the bezel face so a sign flip cannot bring the protruding bars back). Also fixed the stale hard-coded 'Pase BLOCKOUT' label (now code-written; __qaState returns both intended pass and actual DOM text).

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. The structural pass fixed three inherited blockout defects, one of which affected a critical: protruding grille bars rebuilt as real recessed openings (the ventilation critical); two declared-but-empty nodes (side_vents, rear_panel) that had passed a gate rendering nothing, now given geometry and guarded by verifyNoEmptyGroups; and a plane of coincident front-panel parts seated 0.6 mm in. Real structure added (recessed LCD glass, collared button). Notable integrity call: the builder REFUSED to invent the rear receptacle layout — P1 carries no source for its count/type, and a concrete receptacle array is a claim about the product — building only the functionally-forced service panel and fan opening, logging the rest as an open item. Correct, and consistent with the no-unsourced-geometry bar. Cleared to the materials pass.
